main_body: A dead, gothic willow-like tree with a drooping dark canopy of hanging branches over a thick trunk with a hollow, standing on a small base plinth
top_band: No distinct top band; the canopy is an organic mass of dark brown strands, and the crown reads as a rounded volume rather than a flat horizontal surface
evidence: This is an organic tree, so the strict top-surface contract does not really apply to it. The canopy is a rounded volume with drooping strands, drawn with the same viewpoint as the reference trees. It has no flat slab, and no receding side faces are drawn. The trunk meets the ground at a small base, and the viewpoint reads as the usual JRPG tree view. A canopy with hanging strands is a plausible organic 3/4 reading, so I do not fail it as a front elevation.

style.evidence: The tree uses dark brown ramps with tan highlights on the trunk and branches, and a few green and ochre accent pixels. The outline is dark brown rather than black, and it merges into the shading. The texture is streaky, in vertical strands, which suits a weeping form. The canopy is a mostly dark, low-contrast mass, with about 4 distinct lightness steps against the references' 5-6, and it lacks the leaf-clump highlights of the Beodeul trees. The result is slightly thinner and murkier than the references and does not match their clump-by-clump richness, so it fails on density and shading depth.
